name: Harbor Loft Astoria
tagline: Top-floor loft in a converted cannery on the waterfront
description: The top floor of an old cannery building on the Astoria waterfront, converted but not sanded smooth: thick timber, tall windows, and the Riverwalk directly outside the door. One bedroom, a window seat worth the climb, and the working river close enough to hear.
highlights: Assigned parking in the garage below
Ten minutes' walk to the Maritime Museum
amenities: Wifi throughout, patchy signal in the thick walls
Kitchen with induction hob and dishwasher, no oven
Smart TV, bring your own streaming logins
houseRules: No pets — building rules, no exceptions
No smoking or vaping anywhere, including the balcony
Maximum two guests, no additional overnight visitors
